sections.text: The fusion preserves MEF2D DNA-binding and dimerization regions and changes transcriptional regulation, defining a MEF2D-rearranged B-ALL program. These leukemias often have weak CD10 expression and increased HDAC9-associated transcription.

audit_evidence.location: Results: RNAseq; clinical/pathological features; deregulation of MEF2D targets; Figures 1,2,4, PDF pages 2-6
audit_evidence.scope: Ordered pairs, MADS-box retention, weak CD10/HDAC9 and increased transcriptional activity.

sections.text: MEF2D-rearranged B-ALL had inferior unadjusted event-free survival in the COG AALL0232 cohort; the association was not independently significant after adjustment for age, MRD and leukocyte count.

report_comment.text: MEF2D encodes a MADS-box transcription factor involved in differentiation and cell survival. BCL9 encodes BCL9 transcriptional coactivator. The fusion preserves MEF2D DNA-binding and dimerization regions and changes transcriptional regulation, defining a MEF2D-rearranged B-ALL program. These leukemias often have weak CD10 expression and increased HDAC9-associated transcription. MEF2D-rearranged B-ALL had inferior unadjusted event-free survival in the COG AALL0232 cohort; the association was not independently significant after adjustment for age, MRD and leukocyte count.
